title: Tickets
description:
Write a class `Ticket` for an event.

- `Ticket(std::string_view event, int priceCents)`.
- Every ticket gets a unique `number()`: the first ticket ever created is 1, the next 2, and so on. A `static` counter hands the numbers out.
- `static int issued()` says how many tickets have been created so far.
- `int price() const`.
- The event name is private and has **no getter**. Instead, declare a **friend** function `bool sameEvent(const Ticket& a, const Ticket& b)` that is allowed to compare the private names.
hints: A `static inline int s_issued{ 0 };` hands out numbers: the constructor does `m_number = ++s_issued;`.
Declare the friend inside the class, `friend bool sameEvent(const Ticket& a, const Ticket& b);`, and define it outside like a normal function; it may read `a.m_event`.
